newsitem.title: CHILE: SOCCER-CHILE COACH SHORT OF PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHILE COACH SHORT OF PLAYERS.

text.p: Chile coach Nelson Acosta, aiming to take his country to the World Cup finals for the first time in 16 years, was let down on Monday when only half his squad appeared for training.
Acosta picked 24 players for a training camp but only 12 were present on the first day. "This is a lack of respect," he said.
He later admitted that players from national champions Colo Colo may not have been told about the session because of an "administrative mistake".
But he was adamant that absentees from Cobreloa had been given notice.
Chile, seventh in the nine-team South American qualifying group, face Brazil in a friendly on April 2. They then play Venezuela at home in a World Cup game.
Only three points separate Chile from fourth-placed Ecuador in the fierce contest for the four places at the finals.
